finding.claim: withoutLeadingSlash("/") returns "/" instead of "" because empty result falls back to "/", breaking append/join/resolve that expect stripped slash.
finding.title: withoutLeadingSlash returns slash for slash input

verifier.reason: At utils.ts:235-236, withoutLeadingSlash("/") slices to "" and then falls back via || "/" to return "/", and url.ts:124-126 concatenates that result after withTrailingSlash in append, so a root pathname yields a double slash rather than a stripped segment.

finding.claim: withFragment cannot clear fragment: early return on falsy hash returns input unchanged, making the hash==="" branch unreachable, contradicting documented withFragment("/foo#bar","") => "/foo".
finding.title: withFragment early return makes clearing fragment impossible

verifier.reason: Confirmed: utils.ts:737 returns input unchanged when hash is falsy, so the documented empty-string case at utils.ts:731 never reaches the hash === "" branch at utils.ts:741, making that branch unreachable and clearing via withFragment impossible.

verifier.reason: The code at parse.ts:134 destructures only the first two elements of input.split(":"), so a third colon-separated segment such as ':word' in 'user:pass:word' is discarded and the password is truncated.

finding.claim: $URL.searchParams appends array elements raw while non-array branch JSON-stringifies objects, so array object values become [object Object] instead of JSON, inconsistent with stringifyQuery/encodeQueryValue.
finding.title: searchParams array values skip JSON stringify

verifier.reason: Confirmed: url.ts:73-80 appends array elements raw via p.append(name, v) while the non-array branch JSON-stringifies non-strings, and encoding.ts:59-61 plus query.ts:105-111 show encodeQueryValue/encodeQueryItem JSON-stringify each array element, so an object element is coerced to [object Object] inconsistently.
